run_GoalFollower_agent: run the GoalFollower agent benchmark with a task config and success distance threshold
run_RandomAgent_benchmark: run the RandomAgent benchmark evaluation using a Habitat task config YAML file
run_ForwardOnlyAgent_benchmark: run the ForwardOnlyAgent benchmark that only moves forward until the goal is reached
run_RandomForwardAgent_benchmark: run the RandomForwardAgent benchmark with 80 percent forward movement probability
run_agent_cli: run the simple agents CLI with --agent-class, --task-config, and --success-distance arguments
